description:
The image features a keyboard illuminated by a bright light, situated on a wooden surface. The keyboard is predominantly gray in color, with black keys and white lettering on the keys. Notably, the keys on the left side of the keyboard are labeled with letters of the alphabet, while the keys on the right side are labeled with numbers and symbols. A white cord extends from the keyboard, stretching upward to the top center of the image, where it disappears from view.
